question: Does a yogi's animation of another body create the same kind of knowledge lineage?
premises: A yogi may enter and animate another body by will.
Such a case is compared to a corpse body entered by a yogi.
This does not establish the same kind of knowledge-lineage continuity.
inference: Animating another body is not equivalent to transmitting a knowledge lineage.
uncertainties: The verse is elliptical and relies on the following verse to complete the argument.
plain_english: It is not the same as that, like a corpse body entered by a yogi's will. When a yogi causes life in another body and so on, while keeping his own,
